content.short: ETH Lift is a CLI toolkit that supports Foundry and Brownie projects.
content.description: ETH Lift centers on two CLI tasks that are not widely addressed by other tool suites: diffing and flattening smart contracts. The tool enables developers to run queries that generate a diff for a file not yet registered, including local sources, when compared to a version live on the mainnet. Brownie and Foundry users can perform these tasks with ease, and Hardhat support is planned for the future.
